name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text:
The European Parliament has signed off its own spending for 2024, which came to about 2.38 billion euros. The report asks Parliament to tighten its rules on money and conduct. It wants faster repayment of Members' travel costs, stronger protection against cyber attacks and foreign interference, and clearer declarations of Members' financial interests. It also flags serious concerns about money spent by the former Identity and Democracy group, which is now under investigation by the European Public Prosecutor's Office.

- Parliament formally approves its 2024 accounts; the changes are requests and recommendations, not new laws.
- Affects Members, their assistants and Parliament's staff, especially on travel payments, data security and ethics rules.
- Next: Parliament's leadership and administration must report back on recovery of misspent group funds and other follow-ups.
